notes.bukhari:1487: Both complete own fields report the prohibition on selling fruit until ripeness becomes apparent. notes.bukhari:1489: Both complete own fields supply Ibn Umar's report of Umar giving the horse, later seeing its sale, wanting to buy it, requesting permission and the actual no-taking-back reply. Retain the separately attributed subsequent conditional Ibn Umar practice of giving again anything he bought from his own charity. The appended parenthesis restates nonuse and comments on chapter/report correspondence; it is explanatory apparatus, not an extra event. Preserve it as context together with the prefatory chain, without losing the actual conditional practice before it.
notes.bukhari:1493: Both complete fields contain the actual intended purchase/emancipation of Barira, owners' wala condition, consultation/reply and the subsequent meat/charity-versus-gift encounter. The parenthetic enslaved status is the status of the person in this actual purchase/emancipation transaction and remains source-qualified material scope. notes.bukhari:1500: Both complete own fields state the appointment of the source-named Abdullah ibn Lutbiyah from Banu Asad to collect Banu Sulaym zakat, his return and actual accounting. Keep every source-named group and the two actions without correcting names from memory. The opening multistep chain, including its father-name gloss, is context; the final Abu Humayd attribution remains supported by exact source context and speaker metadata.
notes.bukhari:1501: Both complete own fields supply the Urayna people's difficulty with Medina's climate, the actual historically reported permission, the herdsman's killing, camel flight, pursuit, capture and the reported punishments and stone-chewing. Preserve every actual action and source restriction without presenting historical treatment wording as current advice. The parenthetic assertion that this was the cure for their particular disease appears as an explanatory medical aside and should remain original context; the already supplied illness/permission narrative remains. Retain the parenthetic those-camels relation identifying the killed herdsman's charge and the heat-intensity causal link within the narrated punishment. The final corroborating-route list and multistep prefatory chain are apparatus. These distinctions require exact own-field cuts, not blanket parenthesis deletion.
